result.instructions: Tools for Luma, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which events on our calendar are coming up in the next 30 days?"; "How many guests are approved for Thursday's dinner, and how many are waitlisted?"; "Show the event submissions that are waiting for approval.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Luma data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run luma_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run luma_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run luma_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. luma_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: luma_get_api_key
tools.title: Get the API key details
tools.description: Return the details of the calendar API key in use: its name, scope, calendar and last-used time. Good first call to confirm the key works. Luma API: GET /v1/api-keys/get-self.

tools.name: luma_get_calendar
tools.title: Get the calendar
tools.description: Return the calendar that the API key manages: name, slug, launch status and settings. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/get.

tools.name: luma_list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List the events on the calendar, approved by default, with upcoming or past filters and cursor paging. Set status to pending to see submissions waiting for approval. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/events/list.

after.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Only events starting after this time.

before.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Only events starting before this time.

pagination_limit.description: Items to return. The server caps the page size.

tools.name: luma_lookup_event
tools.title: Look up an event
tools.description: Find an event by its Luma event_id or by its lu.ma / luma.com URL. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/events/lookup.

url.description: The lu.ma or luma.com event URL.

platform.description: Event platform for the URL lookup.

tools.name: luma_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Return one event's full details, for an event you manage or can see. Luma API: GET /v1/events/get.

event_id.description: Event ID, starts with evt- (from luma_list_calendar_events).

tools.name: luma_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List the guests registered for an event, optionally filtered by approval status, with cursor paging. Luma API: GET /v1/events/guests/list.

event_id.description: Event ID, starts with evt- (from luma_list_calendar_events).

pagination_limit.description: Items to return. The server caps the page size.

tools.name: luma_get_guest
tools.title: Get a guest
tools.description: Return one guest's registration, status, tickets and check-in state for an event. Luma API: GET /v1/events/guests/get.

event_id.description: Event ID, starts with evt- (from luma_list_calendar_events).

tools.name: luma_list_ticket_types
tools.title: List ticket types
tools.description: List the ticket types of an event. Set include_hidden to true to add hidden ticket types. Luma API: GET /v1/events/ticket-types/list.

event_id.description: Event ID, starts with evt- (from luma_list_calendar_events).

tools.name: luma_get_ticket_type
tools.title: Get a ticket type
tools.description: Return one ticket type by its id. Luma API: GET /v1/events/ticket-types/get.

tools.name: luma_list_event_coupons
tools.title: List event coupons
tools.description: List the discount coupons that apply to one event. Luma API: GET /v1/events/coupons/list.

event_id.description: Event ID, starts with evt- (from luma_list_calendar_events).

pagination_limit.description: Items to return. The server caps the page size.

tools.name: luma_list_calendar_coupons
tools.title: List calendar coupons
tools.description: List the discount coupons of the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/coupons/list.

pagination_limit.description: Items to return. The server caps the page size.

tools.name: luma_list_blasts
tools.title: List email blasts
tools.description: List the email blasts sent to the guests of one event. Luma API: GET /v1/events/blasts/list.

event_id.description: Event ID, starts with evt- (from luma_list_calendar_events).

tools.name: luma_get_blast
tools.title: Get an email blast
tools.description: Return one email blast with its subject, body and send status. Luma API: GET /v1/events/blasts/get.

tools.name: luma_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Search the calendar's audience by name or email, filter by contact tags or membership status, and sort by activity. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/contacts/list.

tags.description: Contact tag names or IDs to filter by.

pagination_limit.description: Items to return. The server caps the page size.

tools.name: luma_list_contact_tags
tools.title: List contact tags
tools.description: List the contact tags defined on the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/contact-tags/list.

tools.name: luma_list_event_tags
tools.title: List event tags
tools.description: List the event tags defined on the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/event-tags/list.

tools.name: luma_list_calendar_admins
tools.title: List calendar admins
tools.description: List the admins of the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/admins/list.

tools.name: luma_list_membership_tiers
tools.title: List membership tiers
tools.description: List the membership tiers of the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/memberships/tiers/list.

pagination_limit.description: Items to return. The server caps the page size.

tools.name: luma_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for the account. Luma API: GET /v1/webhooks/list.

pagination_limit.description: Items to return. The server caps the page size.

tools.name: luma_search_places
tools.title: Search places
tools.description: Search for a venue or address by text. Luma API: GET /v1/places/search.

query.description: Venue or address text, for example 'Chelsea Market'.

tools.name: luma_update_guest_status
tools.title: Update a guest's status
tools.description: Set a guest's status for an event: approved, declined, waitlist or pending_approval. No email is sent unless send_email is true. Luma API: POST /v1/events/guests/update-status.

event_id.description: Event ID, starts with evt- (from luma_list_calendar_events).

guest_id.description: Guest ID (gst-), a ticket key, a guest key (g-) or the guest's email.

should_refund.description: Refund a paid guest moved to declined, waitlist or pending (default false).

send_email.description: Email the guest about the change (default false).

message.description: Personal note in the email. Used only when send_email is true.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Luma
prompts.description: What you can do with Luma here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_upcoming_events_and_their_guest_counts
prompts.title: Check upcoming events and their guest counts
prompts.description: List the upcoming events of the calendar. Then list the guests of one event to count the approved and waitlisted ones.

prompts.name: review_event_submissions_waiting_for_approval

prompts.description: List the submissions that are pending approval. Open one event to read its details and its ticket types.

prompts.name: approve_or_decline_a_guest_registration
prompts.title: Approve or decline a guest registration
prompts.description: Find the guest on the event list and read the registration. Then set the guest status. No email is sent unless you ask for one.

prompts.name: review_email_blasts_and_coupons_for_an_event
prompts.title: Review email blasts and coupons for an event
prompts.description: List the email blasts sent to the guests of one event and read one blast. List the coupons that apply to the event.

prompts.name: look_up_an_event_from_its_luma_link
prompts.title: Look up an event from its Luma link
prompts.description: Paste a lu.ma or luma.com link to find the event. Then read its full details.
